entities.name: Magic sword (wrought iron)
entities.description: While wielded: You roll critical damage Saves with Advantage. Magic swords only mark usage when a 6 is rolled. Roll its class: d6, 1-4 Medium, 5 Light, 6 Heavy. 1-in-6 is cursed.

entities.name: Magic sword (intricate Fae design)
entities.description: While wielded: You may disguise yourself as any mouse-sized creature. Magic swords only mark usage when a 6 is rolled. Roll its class: d6, 1-4 Medium, 5 Light, 6 Heavy. 1-in-6 is cursed.

entities.name: Magic sword (rusty nail)
entities.description: Critical damage: Give a Frightened Condition. Magic swords only mark usage when a 6 is rolled. Roll its class: d6, 1-4 Medium, 5 Light, 6 Heavy. 1-in-6 is cursed.

entities.name: Magic sword (snake fang)
entities.description: Critical damage: Deal d6 additional damage to DEX. Magic swords only mark usage when a 6 is rolled. Roll its class: d6, 1-4 Medium, 5 Light, 6 Heavy. 1-in-6 is cursed.

entities.name: Magic sword (toy soldier's sabre)
entities.description: While wielded: If you lead a warband, they have +1 Armour. Magic swords only mark usage when a 6 is rolled. Roll its class: d6, 1-4 Medium, 5 Light, 6 Heavy. 1-in-6 is cursed.

entities.name: Magic sword (water-worn glass)
entities.description: While wielded: You can hold breath underwater for 1 Turn. Magic swords only mark usage when a 6 is rolled. Roll its class: d6, 1-4 Medium, 5 Light, 6 Heavy. 1-in-6 is cursed.

entities.name: Magic sword (wolf tooth)
entities.description: Critical damage: Your next attack is Enhanced. Magic swords only mark usage when a 6 is rolled. Roll its class: d6, 1-4 Medium, 5 Light, 6 Heavy. 1-in-6 is cursed.

entities.name: Magic sword (silver sewing needle)
entities.description: Critical damage: Clear all usage dots from a non-spell item in your inventory. Magic swords only mark usage when a 6 is rolled. Roll its class: d6, 1-4 Medium, 5 Light, 6 Heavy. 1-in-6 is cursed.

entities.name: Magic sword (thorny rose stem)
entities.description: Critical damage: Remove a Condition. Magic swords only mark usage when a 6 is rolled. Roll its class: d6, 1-4 Medium, 5 Light, 6 Heavy. 1-in-6 is cursed.

entities.name: Magic sword (congealed shadow)
entities.description: While wielded: You are invisible when standing perfectly still. Magic swords only mark usage when a 6 is rolled. Roll its class: d6, 1-4 Medium, 5 Light, 6 Heavy. 1-in-6 is cursed.

entities.name: Fireball
entities.description: Shoot a fireball up to 24". Deal [SUM] + [DICE] damage to all creatures within 6".

Stats.Effect: Shoot a fireball up to 24". Deal [SUM] + [DICE] damage to all creatures within 6".
Stats.Recharge: Burn in the heart of a raging fire for three days and nights.

entities.name: Heal
entities.description: Heal [SUM] STR damage and remove the Injured Condition from a creature.

Stats.Effect: Heal [SUM] STR damage and remove the Injured Condition from a creature.
Stats.Recharge: Cut self for d6 STR damage, sprinkle the spell with the blood.

entities.name: Magic Missile
entities.description: Deal [SUM] + [DICE] damage to a creature within sight.

Stats.Effect: Deal [SUM] + [DICE] damage to a creature within sight.
Stats.Recharge: Drop from a height of at least 30ft. Touch the spell within one Turn.

entities.name: Fear
entities.description: Give the Frightened Condition to [DICE] creatures.

Stats.Effect: Give the Frightened Condition to [DICE] creatures.
Stats.Recharge: Receive the Frightened Condition from a hostile creature while carrying the spell.

entities.name: Darkness
entities.description: Create a [SUM] x 2" diameter sphere of pure darkness for [DICE] Turns.

Stats.Effect: Create a [SUM] x 2" diameter sphere of pure darkness for [DICE] Turns.
Stats.Recharge: Leave uncovered in a lightless place for three days.

entities.name: Restore
entities.description: Remove Exhausted or Frightened Condition from [DICE] + 1 creatures

Stats.Effect: Remove Exhausted or Frightened Condition from [DICE] + 1 creatures
Stats.Recharge: Bury in a peaceful field or riverbank for three days.

entities.name: Be Understood
entities.description: Make your meaning clear to [DICE] creatures of another species for [DICE] Turns.

Stats.Effect: Make your meaning clear to [DICE] creatures of another species for [DICE] Turns.
Stats.Recharge: Give away freely to a creature of another species.

entities.name: Ghost Beetle
entities.description: Create an illusory beetle that can carry 6 inventory slots for [DICE] x 6 Turns.

Stats.Effect: Create an illusory beetle that can carry 6 inventory slots for [DICE] x 6 Turns.
Stats.Recharge: Bury in a beetle graveyard for three nights.

entities.name: Light
entities.description: Force [DICE] creatures to make a WIL save or become stunned. Alternately, create light as bright as a torch for [SUM] turns.

Stats.Effect: Force [DICE] creatures to make a WIL save or become stunned. Alternately, create light as bright as a torch for [SUM] turns.
Stats.Recharge: Catch in the first light of a sunrise and the last light of sunset for three days.

entities.name: Invisible Ring
entities.description: Creates [DICE] x 6" ring of force. It is invisible and immovable. Lasts [DICE] Turns.

Stats.Effect: Creates [DICE] x 6" ring of force. It is invisible and immovable. Lasts [DICE] Turns.
Stats.Recharge: Build an iron ring the same size as last cast. Pass the spell though it. Dissolves the ring.

entities.name: Knock
entities.description: Open a door or container, as if a Save were made with STR score of 10 + [DICE] x 4.

Stats.Effect: Open a door or container, as if a Save were made with STR score of 10 + [DICE] x 4.
Stats.Recharge: Put in a locked box, inside a locked box, inside a locked box. Leave for three days.

entities.name: Grease
entities.description: Cover [DICE] x 6" area in slippery, flammable grease. Creatures in the area must make a DEX save or fall prone.

Stats.Effect: Cover [DICE] x 6" area in slippery, flammable grease. Creatures in the area must make a DEX save or fall prone.
Stats.Recharge: Rub all over in animal fat. Leave until it putrefies.

entities.name: Grow
entities.description: Grow a creature to [DICE] + 1 times its original size for 1 Turn.

Stats.Effect: Grow a creature to [DICE] + 1 times its original size for 1 Turn.
Stats.Recharge: Leave in the highest branches of a tall tree for three days.

entities.name: Invisibility
entities.description: Make creature invisible for [DICE] Turns. Any movement reduces duration by 1 Turn.

Stats.Effect: Make creature invisible for [DICE] Turns. Any movement reduces duration by 1 Turn.
Stats.Recharge: Go a day without opening your eyes once, while holding the spell.

entities.name: Catnip
entities.description: Turn object into an irresistible lure for cats. Lasts [DICE] Turns.

Stats.Effect: Turn object into an irresistible lure for cats. Lasts [DICE] Turns.
Stats.Recharge: Give a cat a gift it truly desires.

entities.name: Cat
entities.description: Wants to be served. If mice pledge fealty and give bribes, they may be allowed to live.

Notes.Special: Cat lords: Balthazar - Loves to eat the finest delicacies; Melchior - Loves gold, jewels and wealth; Solomon - Plays cruel games with captives; Hammurabi - Rules with harsh, unbending logic; Nefertiti - Loves art, poetry and beautiful things; Zenobia - Forming an army of conquest, wants to rule.
Notes.Wants: to be served. If mice pledge fealty and give bribes, they may be allowed to live

entities.name: Centipede
entities.description: Wants to wander and devour.

Notes.Critical damage: Venom takes effect, d12 damage to STR
Notes.Special: Chilling centipedes: Giant - As big as a snake. 12hp, STR 15, Armour 2; Swimming - Drags prey under water; Tiger - Yellow and black bands, d8 damage bite; Glutton - Always hungry, never stops growing; Racer - A delicacy, if you can catch them; Feathered - Can glide short distances.

entities.name: Crow
entities.description: Wants to protect the secret hallowed places from those that would do them harm.

Notes.Special:
Flies 3x normal speed, knows two songs
Crow songs: Dawn - Create a blindingly bright light; Sorrow - All who hear: Make WIL save or take Frightened; Sight - Vaguely foretell a future event; Wind - Powerful gust. Make STR save or knocked down.; Past - See past event concerning those present; Truth - All who hear: Cannot lie while the song lasts.
Notes.Wants: to protect the secret hallowed places from those that would do them harm

entities.name: Faerie
entities.description: Wants to further the Faerie Queen's strange agenda.

Notes.Special:
Knows one spell
Faerie agendas: Kidnapping baby mice, to raise as their own; Giving gifts that cause violent jealousy; Playing music that bewitches mice into their service; Using a glamour to appear as a mouse in distress; Rotting the food in winter storehouses; Tricking a settlement out of their legal standing.
Notes.Wants: to further the Faerie Queen's strange agenda

entities.name: Frog
entities.description: Wants to gallantly complete their quest.

Notes.Special:
Always goes first unless surprised, leaps 2x normal speed
Frog knights-errant: Gwal - Strong, kind of heart and simple of mind; Phillip - Cursed human, searching for a cure; Lurf - Unsound sense of honor, rash in anger; Slup - Set on slaying a great beast, no matter the cost; Uuu - Desperate to prove their strength at jousting; Puc - Searching for the legendary Mug of Truth.

entities.name: Ghost
entities.description: Wants freedom from the pain that binds them to the mortal realm.

Notes.Special:
Only harmed by silver or magic weapons
Also: ghostly power.
Ghostly powers: Shimmer - Create d3 illusions of itself; Poltergeist - Throws a creature/object d6 x 6"; Entrap - Pull a creature into the spirit realm for a Round; Doom - Give Frightened Condition to a creature; Rot - Destroys all rations carried by a creature; Incorporeal - Float into wall/floor, reappear elsewhere.
Notes.Wants: freedom from the pain that binds them to the mortal realm

entities.name: Mouse
entities.description: Wants to feel safe.

Notes.Special: Rival mouse adventurers: Thistle - Disgraced knight, still haughty; Belladonna - Off-kilter wizard, looking for spells; Hayseed - Trying to steal enough to buy back their farm; Mandrake - Con artist. Appears unthreatening; Marigold - Loves fire. Fears its absence; Leif - Massive mouse exiled from far away land.

entities.name: Owl
entities.description: Wants to collect rare knowledge and spells.

Notes.Special:
Flies 3x normal speed. Knows two spells
Owl sorcerers: Bezalel - Builds mechanical servants; Morgana - In league with a faerie kingdom; Prospero - Creates chimeric servants; Sparrowhawk - Can shape-shift into any other bird; Crowley - Binds ghosts into spells; Lechuza - Human witch trapped in owl form.
Notes.Wants: to collect rare knowledge and spells

entities.name: Rat
entities.description: Wants easy wealth, to take from the weak.

Notes.Special: Rat gangs: Dedratz - Construct elaborate scavenged traps; Water Rats - Expert riverboat navigators; Lab Rats - Bizarre looks, innate magical abilities; Trashknights - 1 armour tin breastplates and helms; Gentlerats - Top hats and rumpled suits; The Kings - Tails locked together in gordian knot.
Notes.Wants: easy wealth, to take from the weak

entities.name: Snake
entities.description: Wants to sleep undisturbed.

Notes.Critical damage: Swallow whole, d4 STR damage per Round until rescued or escape
Notes.Special: Strange snakes: Wood - Carved stick of wood, ensorcelled into life; Shadow - Slithers always just out of sight; Bone - Snake skeleton, raised from the dead; Eel - Lives underwater. Raises stolen snake eggs; Scroll - Born with a spell etched into its scales; Drake - Has wings, breathes small gouts of fame.

entities.name: Spider
entities.description: Wants to feed its babies.

Notes.Special: Spider species: Widow - Bright red markings, d10 damage bite; Wolf - Furry, hunts in packs of d6 spiders; Longlegs - Mostly peaceful, can walk on water; Architect - Weave confusing tunnels of webs; Blink - As an action, can teleport d6 x 10"; Ghost - Can only be harmed by silver or magic weapons.
